claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: JNJ-26481585 is a pan-histone deacetylase inhibitor; at 2.5 uM it is expected to cause histone hyperacetylation, oxidative stress, mitochondrial injury and apoptosis across many cancer cell lines, producing broad cytotoxicity.
